content: विच्छेदः .²1 Cutting asunder, cutting, dividing, separation; किं वा भणामि विच्छेददारुणायासकारिणि <ls>Māl. 6. 11</ls>. .²2 Breaking; विच्छेदः सहृदययेव हारयष्टपा <ls>Śi. 8. 51</ls>. .²3 Break, interruption, cessation, discontinuance; विच्छेदमाप भुवि यस्तु कथाप्रबन्धः <ls>K.</ls>; पिण्डविच्छेददर्शिनः <ls>R. 1. 66</ls>. .²4 Removal, prohibition. .²5 Dissension. .²6 A section, or division of a book. .²7 Interval, space. .²8 Interruption in family succession, failure of issue. .²9 Distinction, difference, variety.
